# Contributing

This is a personal fork, maintained for one person's own use. Issues are disabled
and pull requests are not expected.

If you want to contribute to the projects this build is made of, go upstream:

- [Telegram Desktop](https://github.com/telegramdesktop/tdesktop)
- [AyuGram](https://github.com/AyuGram/AyuGramDesktop)

Build instructions for this fork live in [docs/building-win-x64.md](../docs/building-win-x64.md).
